μ0=1、左右(ρ,vx,vy,vz,p,Bx,By,Bz)=(1,0,0,0,1,0.75,1,0)/(0.125,0,0,0,0.1,0.75,−1,0)。初期不連続x=0.5をセル界面へ合わせる。既存solve_1dの固定定義とJSONの一致を検査し、変更した物理定義は拒否。CFL=0.35。 Conditions, commands and validation scope Assumptions μ0=1, with left/right (ρ,vx,vy,vz,p,Bx,By,Bz)=(1,0,0,0,1,0.75,1,0)/(0.125,0,0,0,0.1,0.75,−1,0). The initial jump x=0.5 is face-aligned. JSON must match the unchanged solve_1d benchmark definition; altered physical definitions are rejected. CFL=0.35. Use these commands in the working directory specified by the execution guide after extracting the ZIP. A command may execute several cases in the package. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python run_recipe.py --input recipes/brio-wu.json --output output-brio-wu python -m pytest -q tests/test_recipes.py Validation limits The 512-cell reference uses the same solver and is neither exact nor independent, nor a proof of uniqueness of MHD weak solutions. Density difference 0.03 allows a mean absolute discrepancy of 3% of left density 1 for this educational test. Positivity retries and HLLE fallbacks are counted; reconstruction positivity-scaling activations are not exposed by the existing API. Positive output alone certifies neither general positivity nor absence of reconstruction changes.
